skill.name: architect
skill.description: Plan complex software features, compare architecture options, and document technical decisions with clear tradeoffs and rollout risks.
skill.summary: Design software architecture plans with tradeoffs, risks, and phased implementation guidance.
skill.author: 0xSero

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns, no executable code, and no detected risk factors. Manual review found this is a prompt-only architecture planning skill with no evidence of malicious intent.

content.value_statement: Complex features often fail when architecture decisions are unclear. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compare options, expose risks, and produce implementation plans.
actual_capabilities: Clarifies requirements and constraints before proposing a design.
Compares architecture alternatives with pros and cons.
Identifies technical risks, dependencies, and rollout concerns.
Produces structured plans and architecture overviews.
Highlights decisions that need stakeholder alignment.
limitations: Does not edit files or execute commands.
Requires project context for accurate design recommendations.
Does not replace formal security, reliability, or compliance review.
Cannot validate runtime behavior without user-provided evidence.

use_cases.title: Plan a Complex Feature
use_cases.description: Break a large feature into architecture decisions, dependencies, phases, and risks before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Review a Technical Direction
use_cases.description: Compare competing design options and identify tradeoffs that should be resolved before a team commits.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Architecture Brief
use_cases.description: Turn loose requirements into a concise system overview for stakeholders and implementation teams.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify Requirements
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for shaping a feature idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me clarify the requirements and constraints for this feature: [feature]. Ask focused questions before proposing architecture.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for choosing between designs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these architecture options for [system]: [option A], [option B], and [option C]. Include pros, cons, risks, and decision criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Implementation Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for sequencing technical work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased implementation plan for [feature]. Include dependencies, migration steps, validation points, rollback options, and stakeholder decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Review Architecture Risks
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before committing to a design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this architecture proposal for [system]. Identify scaling, reliability, security, data, operational, and delivery risks with mitigation options.

output_examples.input: Plan an event-driven notification system for a SaaS product.
output_examples.output: A structured architecture overview with components, event flow, delivery guarantees, failure modes, phased rollout steps, and open decisions.

output_examples.input: Compare a monolith module, internal service, and managed platform for billing.
output_examples.output: A tradeoff matrix covering ownership, complexity, data consistency, compliance, migration cost, and recommended decision criteria.

output_examples.input: Review a proposed migration from REST endpoints to GraphQL.
output_examples.output: A risk-focused review covering client impact, schema governance, caching, authorization, observability, rollout sequence, and stakeholder alignment.

best_practices: Provide current architecture, constraints, and nonfunctional requirements.
Ask for tradeoffs when multiple designs appear viable.
Use the plan as input for implementation, review, and stakeholder discussion.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a final design without sharing system context.
Do not treat recommendations as verified production behavior.
Do not skip security, reliability, or data reviews for high-risk systems.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps plan software architecture, compare design options, and outline implementation phases.

faq.question: Can it write or edit code?
faq.answer: No. The skill is configured for planning and review, not file editing or command execution.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through the marketplace metadata.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide goals, constraints, existing architecture, expected scale, data boundaries, and deadlines.

faq.question: Is it useful for early product ideas?
faq.answer: Yes. It can clarify requirements and identify decisions before implementation planning begins.

faq.question: Does it replace an architecture review?
faq.answer: No. Use it to prepare review material and surface risks for human decision makers.
